purpose: Qualify the explicit CPU-cache/CUDA-evaluation composition numerically; resource profile alone cannot do so

fixed_scope.targets: First two ordered targets from the same prospective B128 resource selection; no outcome selection
fixed_scope.state: same source-fixed resource-only state; excluded from donors
fixed_scope.precision: native float32 CPU sparse token arithmetic; CUDA native predictor/normalization/D/h/R

independent_reference: For each member use a CPU complete-feature leaf X and the unchanged native build_uncached_mono_tokens on the full graph.
Select two token rows and transfer them to CUDA through differentiable .to(), run the unchanged native eval raw-score predictor.
Differentiate each selected raw-score channel with respect to the complete CPU X using create_graph=True; retain every private mixed path.
Move complete CPU feature gradients to CUDA through differentiable .to(), apply original direct normalization, ordered stopped-reference D, global h and R.
Compare selected raw-score logits/channels, complete full-X pullback, norm2, D, h, R, q force where independently meaningful, and every private derivative of R; optionally source CE+R separately.
Confirm exact unchanged source/cache/model custody; keep reference allocation/time outside B128 profile.
gate: Real-graph GPU numerical equivalence remains open until reviewed source, predeclared tolerances and actual root-adopted execution
